plane.onboard: Press %2$s to Boost | Press %1$s to Dismount
helicopter.onboard: Press %2$s to TakeOff | Press %1$s to Dismount
text.autoconfig.simpleplanes.title: simple planes
text.autoconfig.simpleplanes.option.TURN: For controllers, a threshold for the joystick movement of the plane
text.autoconfig.simpleplanes.option.EASY: easier flight mode, disables the extreme movements
text.autoconfig.simpleplanes.option.FLY_: Ticks of flying per one coal burn time
text.autoconfig.simpleplanes.option.MANA: mana amount to use when out

simpleplanes.strike_tool_desc: Right-click a block to send a plane crashing into it
simpleplanes.strike_tool_bearing_auto: Run-in bearing: from wherever you stand
simpleplanes.route_wand_desc: Right-click blocks to mark waypoints, sneak + right-click to launch
simpleplanes.runway_tool_desc: Right-click both ends of a runway to survey it
simpleplanes.runway_tool_mode_survey: Mode: survey (right-click both ends of a runway)
simpleplanes.runway_tool_mode_parking: Mode: parking (right-click to mark where aircraft park)
simpleplanes.helipad_tool_desc: Right-click two opposite corners of a landing pad to survey it
simpleplanes.helipad_tool_size: Pad size: %s to %s blocks square; sneak + right-click the air to mark where you stand
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.empty: No airfields registered in this dimension. Survey one with the Runway Survey Tool or /autopilot survey.
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.name_hove: Click for the full survey of %s
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.show_hove: Draw the centreline, thresholds and parking spots with particles
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.unknown: No airfield called %s. Use /autopilot airfields to list them.
simpleplanes.autopilot.helipad.browser_e: No helipads registered in this dimension. Mark one with the Helipad Marker or /autopilot helipad survey.
simpleplanes.autopilot.helipad.name_hove: Click for the full survey of %s
simpleplanes.autopilot.helipad.unknown: No helipad called %s. Use /autopilot helipads to list them.
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.refuse_sh: %s is %s blocks long; an aircraft needs %s to land on it. Survey a longer strip.
simpleplanes.autopilot.browser.refuse_no: %s has no parking marked, so an aircraft has nowhere to start from and nowhere to taxi to after landing. Mark a stand beside the runway with the Runway Survey Tool in parking mode, or /autopilot airfields park "%s" <x y z>.
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.title: %s (%s)
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.threshold: threshold %s: elevation %s, heading %s deg, approach obstacles %s of %s
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.touchdown: touchdown aim %s blocks in, stopping by about %s of %s
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.unusable: TOO SHORT: needs %s blocks, has %s - sorties into it are refused
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.parking_no: no marked parking; a departure uses the apron worked out from the survey and an arrival stops on the runway
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.parking_mi: NO PARKING MARKED: this runway is not finished. Mark at least one stand with the Runway Survey Tool in parking mode, or /autopilot airfields park "%s" <x y z>. Sorties to and from it are refused until you do.
simpleplanes.autopilot.detail.off_centre: centreline is %s blocks off the middle of the strip - run /autopilot airfields resurvey "%s" while standing near it
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.busy: %s is in use by an aircraft; try again when the runway is free.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.resurveyed: Re-surveyed %s: the centreline moved %s blocks onto the middle of the strip. Everything an arrival is flown to moves with it.
Re-surveyed %s; its centreline was already down the middle of the strip.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.resurvey_u: %s is not loaded, and a survey measures real blocks. Go to the runway, or force-load it, and try again.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.blank_name: An airfield name cannot be blank.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.name_taken: There is already an airfield called %s.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.parked: Parking spot %s marked at %s (%s in total).
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.park_on_st: Note: that spot is on the runway itself, so an aircraft waiting there stands on the landing area.
simpleplanes.autopilot.manage.unparked: Removed the parking spot at %s (%s left).
simpleplanes.tower.empty: No airfields registered in this dimension, and no aircraft holding for one.

simpleplanes.tower.taxiing_header: taxiing to a stand (runway already released):
simpleplanes.tower.holding_header: holding (no sequence: the first to poll a free runway takes it):

simpleplanes.tower.waiting_only: %s waiting to depart, none cleared yet
